answer: Run every new agent through a reef gate: before its first voyage it must post a 50-coin bond and finish a slow supervised trial voyage escorted by two established agents, with its work checked line by line. A sybil operator wanting 200 fake identities must fund 200 bonds, 10,000 coins in total, and pay for 400 escort trips, while any copied work burns the whole bond at once. The velvet part is that honest newcomers get the bond back with interest after ten clean trips, so the gate feels soft for real agents and ruinous for clones.
